definitions.gloss: three-day weekend; three consecutive days off
definitions.explanation: Three consecutive holidays, typically formed when a national holiday falls on a Monday or Friday, creating a long weekend. Japan's Happy Monday system creates several three-day weekends per year.

examples.japanese: {来週|らいしゅう}は{三連休|さんれんきゅう}だ。
examples.english: Next week there's a three-day weekend.

examples.japanese: {三連休|さんれんきゅう}を{利用|りよう}して{旅行|りょこう}に{行|い}く。
examples.english: I'm going on a trip taking advantage of the three-day weekend.

examples.japanese: {三連休|さんれんきゅう}の{最終日|さいしゅうび}は{高速道路|こうそくどうろ}が{渋滞|じゅうたい}するので、{早|はや}めに{出発|しゅっぱつ}したほうがいい。
examples.english: The expressways get congested on the last day of a three-day weekend, so it's better to leave early.

notes:
USAGE:
A compound of {三|さん} (three) + {連休|れんきゅう} (consecutive holidays). Japan has several three-day weekends per year thanks to the Happy Monday system, which moved some national holidays to Mondays. The pattern extends to other numbers: {四連休|よんれんきゅう}, {五連休|ごれんきゅう}, etc.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {三連休|さんれんきゅう}を{利用|りよう}して (taking advantage of the three-day weekend)
- {三連休|さんれんきゅう}{初日|しょにち} (the first day of a three-day weekend)
- {三連休|さんれんきゅう}{最終日|さいしゅうび} (the last day of a three-day weekend)
